events.title: BAILA HABIBI: HALLOWEEN PARTY
events.description:
CNE Presents & Fiesta Vibes: Baila Habibi — Detroit Halloween

Baila Habibi takes over The Norwood for Halloween weekend, bringing its cross-cultural club experience to two floors in the heart of Detroit.

Rooted in the collision of Arabic, Latin and global club culture, Baila Habibi moves between Arabic rhythms, reggaeton, Afro House, Latin House and sounds from across the diaspora.

For Halloween, the series expands into a full two-floor experience with DJs, live Cirque Baila Habibi performances, immersive production and late-night energy throughout The Norwood.

Saturday, October 24, 2026
9PM–2AM
The Norwood
6531 Woodward Ave, Detroit, MI

2 Floors
Arabic • Latin • Afro House • Global Sounds

Detroit meets the world for Halloween.

events.title: V.V. Lightbody with John Krautner & Rachele Eve
events.description:
Chicago singer-songwriter & multi-instrumentalist V.V. Lightbody hits the road in support of her latest album Period Piece. 

A sought-after collaborator in Chicago’s indie music scene for over a decade, Lightbody’s third LP is a marvelous showcase of her singular production and arrangement skills, ear-catching melodies, and signature frank lyricism.

She's supported by Detroit-based songwriters and music-makers John Krautner and Rachele Eve.
